title: Recording a Claim Excess Against a ShieldCare Plan
content:
## When an excess is billed

An excess is owed by the customer on an approved claim under a Northbeam ShieldCare Protection Plan, and
it is billed once for that claim. The entry raises the claim excess the customer still owes on that plan by
the amount billed, and the customer sees the excess against the claim and on what the account owes.

## Recording the entry

The excess is recorded with `bill_claim_deductible_d5a520f4`, a care desk tool that is not open by default:
it is unlocked and then called by the agent working the claim. One call books a single excess entry against
the named claim on the named plan and raises the claim excess outstanding on that plan by the same amount,
so the plan's figure and its history agree straight away.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `plan_id` | An identifier: the reference number of the ShieldCare protection plan the claim sits on, read from the plan record retrieved for this customer. |
| `claim_reference` | Copied verbatim: the claim reference the retailer issued when the incident was taken, character for character from the claim entry on the plan's history or from what the customer reads out, with no translation, normalisation, summarisation, addition or deletion. |
| `deductible_amount` | A fixed-format money amount: the excess being billed, in USD to 2 decimal places, rounded half to even at the cent when a longer figure is passed. There is no empty value. |

## What comes back

A single confirmation sentence in plain text, naming the reference of the new excess entry, a string
beginning pdc_, the claim and plan it was billed against, the amount billed in USD to two decimal places,
and the claim excess now outstanding on the plan in USD to two decimal places. A sentence beginning "Claim
excess billed" means the entry was written and the plan's outstanding excess was raised.
